comment: This program's own native-image metadata: the entry point the launcher reaches by JNI, and the JDK's
locale and time-zone data a native run of the calculator was seen to read. Everything else registers
itself: the libraries carry their own (Win32, tactroller, DXGI, the shaders, the standard font atlas), and the processor writes the icon's.
This editor's own fonts (the <families> baked into dev/vexelray/demo/editor/fonts/) are not the library's, so they are listed below,
as are the grammars/ and every jcodings tables/*.bin -core brings (a trace lists only the tables one run loaded).
Still missing: TM4E's Raw* classes, whose registration fails the build (the signed jar's certificates).
Add to it when a native run of this program fails on something the JVM run did not: run it on a JVM
under -agentlib:native-image-agent and keep only the entries naming this program.
